statement: You are given a non-negative integer n and a bit index i, where index 0 is the least significant bit.
Return true if the bit at index i in the binary form of n is 1, and false if it is 0.
One way is to build a mask with only bit i set, 1 << i, and test whether n & (1 << i) is non-zero.

examples.explanation: 13 is 1101 in binary. Reading from the right, bit 2 is 1, so 13 & (1 << 2) = 4, which is non-zero.
